data.name: Thorvald
data.gender_notes: Thorvald is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse, Thorvald means 'Thor's protector' or 'Thor's warrior'. Thor was the Norse god of thunder, strength, and protection. The name reflects the power and courage of the Norse gods. The name Thorvald carries the meaning “Thunder wolf” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thorvald usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder wolf and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Norse god Thor, symbolizing strength, protection, and bravery.
data.etymology: Thorvald belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunder wolf.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thorvald total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Thorvald has its roots in the rich cultural heritage of the Norse mythology. It is a reminder of a time when the world was believed to be governed by powerful gods, and men sought their protection and guidance in their daily lives. The name carries a sense of strength, courage, and the power of nature, which continues to inspire awe and reverence.
data.spiritual_significance: Thorvald is a name that embodies the concept of divine protection. It is a reminder that, no matter how challenging the world may be, we are not alone. Just as Thor protected the Norse people, so can a higher power protect and guide us through life's trials and tribulations. The name encourages us to call upon that power and strength when we need it most.
